# axm mcps disable

Disable an MCP server

## When to use

Disable an MCP server

## Usage

```bash
axm mcps disable [flags] <name>
```

## Arguments

| Name   | Type   | Required | Description                       |
| ------ | ------ | -------- | --------------------------------- |
| `name` | string | Yes      | Name of the MCP server to disable |

## Flags

| Name            | Type    | Required | Description                                                                       |
| --------------- | ------- | -------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `--scope`       | choice  | No       | Disable in project (default) or user-level configuration (choices: project, user) |
| `--yes`, `-y`   | boolean | No       | Disable without confirmation                                                      |
| `--force`, `-f` | boolean | No       | Override constraints that would cause failure                                     |
| `--preview`     | boolean | No       | Display plan without applying                                                     |

Global flags are documented on [Global flags](../global-flags).

## Examples

**Disable an MCP server**

```bash
axm mcps disable context
```

**Preview disabling an MCP server**

```bash
axm mcps disable context --preview
```

## Requirements

None.

## Side effects

None.
